authorization: Owner requested staged reproduction, additional analyses and candidate RQ derivation after setup.
exposure: Paper, source marker tables, library/cell metadata and first matrix-value samples used to establish count semantics have been inspected. No donor gene-effect estimates were inspected before this contract.
source_release: CELLxGENE curated versions recorded in expression_sources_v1.json; current source-linked release, not guaranteed original Seurat bytes
primary_unit: donor within assay and anatomical region
small_cohort_rule: Report individual donor estimates, mean, observed range and leave-one-donor-out summaries; no cell-level population p-values or causal interpretation. Fewer than three eligible donors remains a descriptive coverage hold.
raw_layer: raw/X; require nonnegative finite integer values across all stored entries
normalization: Per-cell raw counts divided by curated full-gene library sum, scaled to 10000 for 10x and 1000000 for SS2, log1p. Pseudobulk sums use library-total sum and log2(CPM+1). Retain original X means separately and audit agreement.
gene_mapping: Exact feature_name; sum multiple stable-ID columns mapping to one symbol, record mappings; report missing genes explicitly. No replacement by an inferred homolog.
populations: Author free_annotation is held fixed. Source reproduction includes lung and blood as deposited; biological contrasts use lung only. Assays remain separate.
source_concordance: Compare exact deposited type counts where labels agree; document broad/specific annotation differences without forcing a match. Reconstruct selected dot-plot summaries and imaging fractions. No claim of a full 58-type unsupervised refit, MAST rerun, spatial replication or complete evolutionary analysis.
extension_decision: Use reproduction estimates to select bounded depth, donor/region, assay or comparator sensitivity branches. Freeze a separate follow-up contract after source results and before running those sensitivities.
figure_assay_note: AT2 dotplot code is in the SS2 notebook and the published colorbar is ln(CPM+1), whereas the caption names 10x; show both assays with their own scales and retain the source inconsistency.
